purpose: Phase 2D development-only proposition benchmark. These IDs and video sources do not overlap the frozen Phase 2B held-out fixture. Labels describe source-grounded propositions, not canonical ontology relations.
bronze_window_policy: SourceWindowResolver defaults; positive cases require a verified lexical_window and quote only transcript text within that window.

expected_propositions.subject_source: run into Tower and just die
expected_propositions.normalization_rationale: Dying to renew the lane state directly supports reset; pulling wave position has no direct closed relation or effect concept.

expected_propositions.subject_source: keep poking and pushing and hitting creeps
expected_propositions.condition_source: when you're playing Push and poke lanes
expected_propositions.normalization_rationale: Repeated poke and push directly support persistent pressure; make sure and crash do not directly identify a closed relation or strategic concept.

expected_propositions.effect_source: their ability to play on Mid
expected_propositions.normalization_rationale: Sweeper has no matching strategic concept, while removing the opponent's ability to play mid directly denies access.

expected_propositions.effect_source: you guys going four for Gwen
expected_propositions.condition_source: if you guys got deep mid push
expected_propositions.normalization_rationale: Deep mid push creates a wave obligation that prevents punishment and enables a four-player local numbers advantage on Gwen.

expected_propositions.condition_source: you guys hard lose level one
expected_propositions.normalization_rationale: Stepping into hook directly grants interaction access; hard lose level one has no direct closed relation or effect concept.
